'Labpack' is the unofficial name for a Minecraft modpack designed by popular Youtuber Ethoslab for his single player modded Youtube series. You can find a playlist of the series here. The modpack was released on the Feed The Beast launcher as a third party pack.

Downloading the pack is simple:

  1. Download the Feed The Beast launcher. You need to put this launcher somewhere that it can have write permissions. A popular and recommended location is c:/ftb. If the 'launch' button on packs is greyed out, please move the launcher somewhere else and set the 'Install Folder' in the options tab to the new location. The game will not launch if the launcher doesn't have proper permissions.

  2. Go to the 3rd party packs tab at the top of the launcher.

  3. At the top right of this tab will be a 'Pack Codes' button. Click that button and enter 'Etho'. It should add the pack to the list.

  4. Launch the 'Etho's LP Pack' from the 3rd party packs tab. It will likely be at the bottom of the list.
